components.text: Create tracks shaft speed (RPM) and stress (SU). A source sets the network cap. A machine spends stress; higher RPM on that machine spends more.$(br)$(br)※ Over cap, the network stalls. It does not break. It jams.
I will not write per-machine SU here — they move between Create versions. Use the Create overlay (goggles / stress gauge) and EMI.$(br)$(br)Source turns. Consumer resists. That is the whole law.
